claim: For every original traceless A,B and rank2 test P with EITHER local marginal rank≤2, the dual gap is ≥0, and equality forces A² normal OR B² normal. Thus BOTH original squares nonnormal imply strict gap for EVERY such P. If a top2 maximizing P has such a local rank, strict T2 follows. The remaining full dual test domain requires BOTH marginal ranks≥3.
equality_proof: For a rank2 A marginal, tight leakage forces A12=A21=0 and A22=−αI, with A11=αI+C traceless C; rank1 marginal is the product endpoint. Let R=Y P on the 2×4 active space. Equality in weighted KyFan duality forces equality in the rank2 partial-trace bound and source relations C=(Tr4R)_0/2, B=(Tr2R)_0/2. Hollow (Tr4R)_0 with a local qubit unitary and write R=[[G,Q],[T,G]]. Equality in the three nonnegative block slacks gives Q,T each zero or scalar times a rank2 orthogonal projection. If both zero, (Tr4R)_0=0⇒C=0 and A normal. If Q=λU≠0, rankR≤2 and the 2D pivot force G=UGU and T=λ^(−1)G². If T=0, G²=0. If T=μV≠0, V=U and G²=λμU. In either case G has tracezero and scalar-square on U, or G is scalar on U; B=G−(Tr G/4)I4 has B² normal (indeed B normal in the scalar case). The Q=0,T≠0 case is symmetric. Hence equality implies at least one original local square normal.
